newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Iscor attracts heavy volumes, edges up.
newsitem.headline: Iscor attracts heavy volumes, edges up.

text.p: Shares in South African steel giant Iscor Ltd attracted heavy volumes on Friday and the share price edged up one cent to 306 cents by 1245 GMT, dealers said.
More than 6.9 million shares changed hands in 99 separate trades as bookover trade of a total of around 3.3 million shares flowed through the market.
"There have been some big bookovers in the stock, but it hasn't moved very much," one dealer said.
One dealer also said there had been a buy order from an unnamed overseas institution for one million shares in the firm.
